title: Open Mic @ Linneman's Riverwest Inn
event_description: Weekly open mic featuring acoustic performers and a featured artist. Musicians and solo performers welcome to share their original songs and covers in an intimate setting.
event_venue_information:
About Linneman's Riverwest Inn

Linneman's Riverwest Inn is an intimate music venue with divey Riverwest charm located in Milwaukee's vibrant Riverwest neighborhood. Opened in 1993 this beloved tavern has become a cornerstone of the local music scene. The venue features two separate but unified spaces - a front bar room with pool table and a back stage area perfect for solo performers or minimally equipped bands.

Weekly Events

In addition to Wednesday open mics Linneman's hosts Poet's Monday - Milwaukee's longest-running poet's open mic beginning at 7:30 PM. The venue regularly features live concerts on weekends showcasing local and touring musicians across various genres. The soundboard is operated by owner Jim Linneman himself who occasionally graces the stage at night's end.

Venue Atmosphere

With its welcoming atmosphere and commitment to supporting local artists Linneman's has earned a reputation as a sweet neighborhood staple. The venue prides itself on providing quality sound in an intimate setting where performers and audience members can connect. TVs in the bar area sometimes broadcast concerts or documentaries and the venue is known for its unique microphone beer holders - a practical touch that performers appreciate.

title: Open Mic @ The Gig
event_description: Weekly open mic night at Milwaukee's Grateful Dead-themed dive bar. Acoustic and electric performers welcome with a focus on jam band and folk music.
event_venue_information:
About The Gig

The Gig is a beloved corner bar in Milwaukee's Riverwest neighborhood that has been serving the community since 2001. Known as Riverwest's hidden gem this Grateful Dead-themed venue combines psychedelic vibes with live music and a welcoming atmosphere. The bar features two pool tables three pinball machines several TVs and cheap drinks making it a favorite local hangout.

Music Programming

The Gig is renowned for its commitment to live music hosting weekly events including Wednesday night open mics and Dead Night every Wednesday featuring Grateful Dead tribute music with drink specials. Sunday afternoons feature weekly Bluegrass Jams that have become a staple of the Milwaukee bluegrass scene attracting members of Chicken Wire Empire The Milbillies and rotating Midwest bluegrass musicians. The venue also hosts regular bluegrass bands like The Bo Randall Band and maintains an active schedule of live performances throughout the week.

Venue Features

The venue includes a spacious pool room extension and a main stage area that serves as the focal point for performances. With a solid patio for outdoor enjoyment and an entertainment room featuring billiards and darts The Gig offers multiple spaces for patrons to enjoy. The bar's icy and wallet-friendly drinks combined with its impeccable music selection create an unforgettable experience for music enthusiasts and Deadheads alike.

title: Jazz Jam @ Centro
event_description: Monthly jazz jam session on first Thursdays featuring local jazz musicians. Open to all jazz players and listeners with no cover charge and drink specials.
event_venue_information:
About Centro Cafe

Centro Cafe (also known as Bar Centro) is a cornerstone of Milwaukee's Riverwest neighborhood jazz scene located on East Center Street. This intimate venue has established itself as one of the premier spots for live jazz in Milwaukee offering performances three to four nights a week. The cafe features a welcoming atmosphere that attracts both seasoned jazz aficionados and newcomers to the genre.

Jazz Programming

Centro hosts a monthly jazz jam session every first Thursday with no cover charge and drink specials making it accessible to all music lovers. The venue regularly features performances by notable Milwaukee jazz musicians and serves as a home for Milwaukee Jazz Institute presentations. Friday and Saturday nights showcase professional jazz acts creating an electrifying soul and jazz atmosphere. The venue has hosted performances by acclaimed artists like B.D. Greer & The Gents and numerous other local and regional jazz talents.

Venue Experience

With reservations available and walk-ins welcome Centro Cafe maintains a balance between intimate club atmosphere and accessibility. The venue's commitment to supporting the Milwaukee jazz community makes it an essential stop for anyone interested in experiencing authentic jazz in a neighborhood setting. The combination of quality music affordable pricing and a genuine love for jazz culture has made Centro a beloved institution in Milwaukee's music scene.

title: Open Mic @ Canni Cafe
event_description: Monthly open mic night featuring emcees vocalists poets and creatives with house band 16 Levels. Hip-hop R&B and spoken word focused event.
event_venue_information:
About Canni Cafe

Canni Cafe has become a vital part of Milwaukee's underground music scene serving as a creative hub for the city's hip-hop R&B and spoken word communities. The venue is known for creating an inclusive atmosphere where emerging and established artists can showcase their talents in a supportive environment.

Open Mic Night

Canni's monthly open mic night has become one of the most anticipated events in Milwaukee's urban music scene. Hosted by Mad Static and backed by the talented house band 16 Levels the event sets the room on fire with performances from emcees vocalists poets and various creatives. The combination of live instrumentation and diverse talent creates an electric atmosphere unique in the Milwaukee scene. Special collaborations with Breaking & Entering and Big Beat MKE bring additional energy featuring previews from the city's hottest beatmakers.

Community Impact

Where creativity meets community the mic is always open at Canni. The venue has established itself as the heartbeat of Milwaukee's underground scene providing a platform for artists who might not find space in more traditional venues. Whether performers are stepping to the mic or audience members are vibing in the crowd Canni's open mic nights offer a chance to discover Milwaukee's next favorite artist and be part of a thriving creative community.

title: Full Band Open Jam @ Nashville North
event_description: Weekly full band open jam hosted by Uncle Don. Musicians welcome to join in on rock country and blues jams with provided backline.
event_venue_information:
About Nashville North

Nashville North MKE opened in June 2022 at 1216 E. Brady Street in Milwaukee's Lower East Side bringing authentic Nashville honky-tonk vibes to Historic Brady Street. The venue features two stages ensuring live music every day of the week making it Milwaukee's premier destination for country rock and blues performances. With a capacity of 120 and a 21+ age requirement the venue creates an intimate yet energetic atmosphere.

Live Music Schedule

Nashville North hosts an impressive lineup of live music including weekly Full Band Open Jams on Saturdays hosted by Uncle Don where musicians can join in on rock country and blues sessions. Tuesday nights feature live bluegrass music with members of Chicken Wire Empire and The Milbillies plus rotating Midwest bluegrass musicians. The venue regularly showcases both local Milwaukee talent like Joe Wray and national touring acts creating diverse programming that honors Milwaukee's vibrant music scene while celebrating country and honky-tonk traditions.

Food and Atmosphere

Nashville North serves hand-held quick eats including specialty hotdogs named after Milwaukee icons (The Uecker The Laverne & Shirley The Dick Bacon) smashburgers hot chicken rotisserie chicken and comfort food favorites. The bar features an extensive selection of canned beverages craft cocktails (Peach Bourbon Smash BBQ Mule) boozy slushes and cold shots. The venue brings the spirit and energy of Nashville's Broadway Street to Milwaukee with quality live music of all genres sound and lighting that rival larger venues and a welcoming atmosphere perfect for bachelorette parties birthdays and nights out with friends.

title: MJI Open Jam @ The Estate
event_description: Milwaukee Jazz Institute jam session open to musicians and listeners of all ages. Free admission with donations welcome.
event_venue_information:
About The Estate

The Estate has been a cornerstone of Milwaukee's jazz scene since the late 1970s hosting both locally and nationally known performers at 2423 North Murray Avenue. This historic venue has maintained its commitment to presenting quality jazz programming for over four decades making it one of the most important jazz venues in the city. Ages 21 and under must be accompanied by a parent making it accessible to younger jazz enthusiasts.

Jazz Programming

The Estate regularly hosts Milwaukee Jazz Institute events including monthly open jam sessions led by faculty artists Mark Davis and Jim Paolo. These free admission events (donations welcome) provide opportunities for musicians of all skill levels to participate and for listeners to experience live jazz improvisation. The Jazz Circle of the Milwaukee Jazz Institute uses The Estate as a home base for free events designed to help youth and adults learn more about jazz in an authentic performance setting.

Historic Significance

As one of the few venues that has continuously presented jazz for nearly 50 years The Estate represents Milwaukee's deep jazz heritage. The venue has witnessed the evolution of Milwaukee's jazz scene from the Bronzeville era through the present day hosting legendary performers and nurturing new generations of jazz musicians. Its intimate setting and dedication to the art form make it an essential destination for anyone serious about experiencing Milwaukee's jazz tradition.

title: Open Mic @ Flame 13 Restaurant and Lounge
event_description: Weekly open mic featuring live music poetry and more. Diverse performers welcome in Milwaukee's vibrant urban music scene.
venue_address: 2230 North Martin Luther King Jr Drive Milwaukee WI
event_venue_information:
About Flame 13 Restaurant and Lounge

Flame 13 Restaurant and Lounge is located at 2230 North Martin Luther King Jr Drive in Milwaukee serving as a hub for the city's urban music and arts community. The venue combines dining and entertainment offering a space where Milwaukee's creative community can gather perform and celebrate local talent.

Open Mic Events

The Mic Over Matter Open Mic hosted by Jae Royal has become Milwaukee's true open mic experience every Monday. This event brings together artists poets singers rappers and creatives from all walks of life to shine on stage. The open mic redefines what it means to take the mic in Milwaukee offering a platform for diverse voices and styles. Whether attendees come to perform or simply vibe the atmosphere is electric and welcoming to all.

Community Focus

Flame 13 has established itself as an important venue for Milwaukee's creative community particularly for hip-hop R&B spoken word and soul music. The restaurant and lounge format allows for a relaxed atmosphere where food drinks and entertainment come together. As a gathering place for artists and music lovers Flame 13 continues to support and showcase the rich diversity of Milwaukee's urban arts scene.
